title: Forg3d WeiLong Pyraminx Ball Core Mod
body_html:
Introducing the Forg3d WeiLong Pyraminx Ball Core Mod. A custom ball-core designed and developed by Kewbz in our UK warehouse. 

How do I install this?

The Forg3d WeiLong Pyra Ball-Core mod kit from Kewbz comes with 2 half ball-cores, which you will just need to superglue onto your original core from your MoYu WeiLong Pyraminx. A very, very tiny drop of super glue will be more than enough to ensure that the ball core stays snug and in place. 

Also in this kit, you will find 6 'edge magnet holders', which will need to be glued into the base of the edges. These edge magnet holders have been made to fit perfectly into the base of the edge pieces.

How long should it take?

The whole installation process should take less than 25 minutes if you are an experienced cuber or have experience/knowledge in dismantling your cubes.

Is there an installation video?

Coming soon 🎥

Please Note: The Core is NOT included in the kit. You will receive 2 ball-cores halves pre-installed with 6 N52 rare earth magnets, and a further 6 edge magnet holders.

title: Prism XMD Tornado V4 Flagship Special Edition (Magnetic, Ball-Core)
body_html:
Introducing the HIGHLY anticipated X-Man Design Tornado V4 3x3 Magnetic (Flagship). The Tornado V3 was one of our best-selling cubes, and we believe the V4 will be even better! Featuring improved magnetic systems and easy-to-use settings, the V4 is built for speed and accuracy, making it perfect for anyone looking to improve get into speed cubing.

Flagship Edition Features:

  • Triple-Mechanical Linkage Magnetic Adjustment System: Adjust your cube with just 8 simple settings, making it quicker and easier to customize for smoother turns.
  • Omnidirectional Core Magnets: Increased stability and high magnetic 'snappy' feel.
  • Visual Multi-Pointed Star Dual-Adjustment System: Use the color-coded settings to fine-tune the cube’s tightness and flexibility to match your style.
  • Blank White Center Cap: FINALLY we have a blank white center cap included in the box for those of you that wish to use the V4 for blind.

Tensioning/Adjustment Settings:

  • 5 Axis Distance Settings: The inner (circle) tension settings allow you to adjust the 'tightness' of the layers, 1 = Loose and 5 = Tight.
  • 5 Elasticity Tension Settings: The outer adjustment settings (noted by a notch on the side of the center piece) allows you to adjust the 'elasticity' of the faces of the cube. The larger the number, the tighter the spring, 1 = Loose and 5 = Tight.

The Tornado V4 Flagship Edition is perfect for competitive cubers who want top performance.

Please Note: Prices are subject to change during the first few days of pre-order.

Introducing the HIGHLY anticipated X-Man Design Tornado V4 3x3 Magnetic (Pioneer). The Tornado V3 was one of our best-selling cubes, and we believe the V4 will be even better! Featuring improved magnetic systems and easy-to-use settings, the V4 is built for speed and accuracy, making it perfect for anyone looking to improve get into speed cubing.

Pioneer Edition Features:

  • Triple-Mechanical Linkage Magnetic Adjustment System: Adjust your cube with just 8 simple settings, making it quicker and easier to customise for smoother turns.
  • 3-Magnetic Edge Piece Positioning System: The special magnets between the edge and corner pieces help you make fast, smooth turns without mistakes.
  • Visual Multi-Pointed Star Dual-Adjustment System: Use the color-coded settings to fine-tune the cube’s tightness and flexibility to match your style.

Tensioning/Adjustment Settings:

  • 5 Axis Distance Settings: The inner (circle) tension settings allow you to adjust the 'tightness' of the layers, 1 = Loose and 5 = Tight.
  • 5 Elasticity Tension Settings: The outer adjustment settings (noted by a notch on the side of the center piece) allows you to adjust the 'elasticity' of the faces of the cube. The larger the number, the tighter the spring, 1 = Loose and 5 = Tight.

The Tornado V4 Pioneer Edition is perfect for competitive cubers who want top performance.

title: Forg3d WeiLong Pyraminx Tip Washer Mod
body_html:
Our MoYu WeiLong Pyraminx Tip Washer Mod reduces friction between the tip and the center piece of the Pyraminx resulting in a 'snappy-er' feel and easier tip turning.

The Kit Includes:

4 x Ultra Thin Washers
4 x Thin Washers
4 x Kind of Thin Washers

Installation Guide:

  1. Remove the tip pieces
  2. Undo the screw (and remove it from the plastic)
  3. Pull out the primary tip (which holds the magnets)
  4. Place screw back into the tip housing and insert your chosen washer onto the bottom of the screw (under the tip housing)
  5. Tighten the screw and replace the caps
  6. Repeat 3 more times

Full page installation guide + video coming soon

title: YJ MGC 4x4 (Magnetic, Micro Actuator)
body_html:
Based on the original YJ MGC 4M, the Micro Actuator is the 2024 update of an older puzzle. However, you may be asking, what exactly is a "Micro Actuator"?

So, What is the MGC Micro Actuator?

The Micro Actuator in the new 2024 MGC 4M is a ring of bearings sat atop a washer which sits below the center piece on each of the 6 faces, this new mechanism ensures effortless turning and reduced friction on the center pieces of each face.

YJ have reduced the size of the packaging and also removed the green sleeve that the bigger, older MGC box had (however, it's still printed onto the box which we were trying to remove when they first arrived 😅).

title: DianSheng Solar 2x2 (Magnetic, UV)
body_html:
Introducing the DianSheng Solar 2M in UV. Prehaps the best UV coated budget cube as of the time of writing (November 2023). New to cubing? You may be asking, what is UV Coating? Well....

  • Anti-Scratch - UV coating reduces the likely hood of scratches forming on the exterior of the puzzle.
  • Enhanced Aesthetics - Many cubers these days prefer the look of UV puzzles.
  • Better Feel & Grip - This one is up for debate, most cubers find that UV coating increases grip and feels a lot nicer than regular frosted. Some, however, prefer the look and feel of frosted plastic.

The DianSheng Soalr 2M UV features 48 internal magnets all housed neatly inside their own slots for increased precision. These slots ensure that the magnets align perfectly when layers align, this creates a smooth, stable feeling cube that offers a satisfying 'click' upon layer alignment.

title: SCS Stardust
body_html:
Stardust is a unique water-based lubricant that is designed to take your cube to its limits without changing its natural “feel”!

Most water-based lubricants suffer from drying out quickly and leaving a "chalky" mess all over your cube's internals which requires you to regularly clean out your cube (no thanks!).

What makes Stardust truly special is that as it dries, it "hardens" which contributes to the long-lasting feel that Stardust offers over other water-based lubricants.

Recommended for: All puzzles

Frequently asked questions

Q: How do I apply Stardust and how much should I use?

A: We recommend 6 drops for most cases. Follow this guide to learn how to apply Stardust.

Q: Does Stardust mix with other lubricants?

A: Yes! Stardust can be used with any of our other lubricants. Combine Stardust with Lunar for an even longer-lasting, super-fast experience!

Q: Can I remove Stardust after it hardens?

A: Yes. When cleaning your cube, use a damp paper towel with warm water.

Q: How long does Stardust last?

A: Stardust has proven to outlast comparable water-based lubricants but the "lifespan" will vary depending on the application, use, and storage.

Do not apply water-based lubricants to screws and springs to avoid possible rusting.

Disclaimer: Product is non-toxic and safe for skin but please refrain from ingesting.

title: YJ Tick Cage
body_html:
The YJ Tick Cage is a fun little game that can be likened to Tic-Tac-Toe. Players take it in turns to either place a coloured block, turn a layer, or flip the cube upside down. The aim of the game is to create a group of 3 blocks of the same colour. 

Contents: 
1 x Cage (with 2 lids)
4 x Blocks of 6 unique colours

Aim:
Be the first to group 3 blocks of the same colour

How to play:
Players take turns to either: place a block into the cage, turn a layer of the cage (like a normal twisty puzzle) or flip the cage upside down. In a 2 player game either player selects 3 colours, in a 3 player game each player selects 2 colours and in a 4 (or more) player game each player selects one colour and discards the rest. Player one will perform one of the above actions, its then the next players turn and so on. 

Note:
You cannot place a block in the center and remember to place the lid back on the cage before flipping it over. Also note, the instruction manual included in the box is written in Chinese, please refer to the rules above.

title: Angstrom Compound X
body_html:
Compound X was developed by CubicleLabs of the USA in August 2018 and has quickly become one of our best selling cube lubes of all time. Compound X is a water based lube designed to increase the speed of any twisty puzzle. How does it work do you ask? Well, Compound X uses the attraction of charged silicone polymers to slow down puzzles at the molecular level.

For an added bonus, this lube is scented with a pomegranate aroma.

title: Lubicle Black
body_html:

Designed especially for metal-to-metal and metal-to-plastic contact, Lubicle Black is ideal for lubing the core and hardware of your puzzles. Apply a small drop to the head of each screw and the bottom of each center piece to unlock the best smoothness and speed a core lube can offer!

Caution: High risk of staining, keep away from garments. We recommend lubing your cubes on top of a paper towel or other disposal surface. To remove the lube from your skin or other surfaces, wash thoroughly, rub with silicone oil, and then rinse with soap and water.

Want to connect this to your PC or display unit? You will need a 2.3mm - 3.5mm audio cable. Buy it here.

Please note: Batteries are not included.

title: DNM-37
body_html:
DNM-37 is a water-based lubricant developed by CubicleLabs in the US that creates a refreshing and lasting burst of speed for your cubes and puzzles. DNM-37 is specially formulated to absorb and retain moisture from the air, which allows it to remain more lubricated and effective for longer than other lubricants on the market.

Instructions
  1. Put 2 drops into the puzzles
  2. Break in the puzzles
  3. Enjoy!

 

Please Note: Cubicle has upgraded their bottles to a new style bottle for better transportation.

title: ShengShou Elite Kilominx
body_html:
The ShengShou Elite Kilominx is a 12 faced, 6x6 version of the original Megaminx. Featuring high quality vinyl stickers and coming pre-lubed makes this puzzle ready to just un-box and scramble.

Weight: 505g

title: QiYi QiHeng S Megaminx
body_html:
The QiYi QiHeng S is the sculpted, stickerless version of the QiYi QiHeng. With a low price point, the QiHeng S Megaminx is perfect for cubers with a low budget.

Weight: 164g

title: QiYi QiHeng Megaminx
body_html:
The QiYi QiHeng Megaminx was released in early 2017 and allows puzzlers of all budgets to get into the wonders of the Megaminx which usually boast a slightly higher price point. This version is the black stickered version of the QiHeng S Megaminx.

Weight: 162g

title: ShengShou 10x10
body_html:
The ShengShou 10x10 was the worlds first mass-produced cubic 10x10. Weighing in at near 3/4 of a kilogram this sure is one big, heavy puzzle, but that doesn't take away from the fun. This puzzle comes with a spare set of standard ShengShou shades.

Weight: 743g

Approx Size: 102.5mm3

title: ShengShou 7x7
body_html: The ShengShou 7x7 is a higher-order cube which comes factory standard lubed and stickered with ShengShou standard shades (you will also receive a spare set of stickers with your cube).

title: QiYi WuHua 6x6 V2
body_html: The QiYi WuHua 6x6 V2 is the newer version of the almighty WuHua 6x6 V1. When designing the WuHua 6x6 V2 QiYi made vast improvements to reinforce the corners, centers and internal parts, this reduces pops and explosions. The WuHua 6x6 V2 is almost incomparable to the V1 with highly improved stability and overall performance.

title: LanLan Curvy Copter
body_html:
The LanLan Curvy Copter is based on the helicopter cube with hints of the QiYi Clover Cube too. The main difference is that the Curvy Copter offers curved axis of rotation. This cube is also known as the Butterfly.

Weight: 129g

Approx Size: 57mm3

title: QiYi QiZheng S2 5x5
body_html: The QiYi QiZheng is a new entry level 5x5 puzzle from QiYi. The QiZheng measures 62mm across all sides and is also very lightweight at only 150grams. Perfect for all cubers, beginners and experts alike.

title: LanLan Flower Copter
body_html:
The LanLan Flower Copter is a beautiful shape mod of the original Curvy Copter cube. This puzzle can turn like the original Curvy Copter but the extra cuts allow for even more scrambling possibilities.

Weight: 153g

Approx Size: 57mm3

title: LanLan Honey Copter
body_html:
Also known as the "Heart Cube", the LanLan Honey Copter is a shape mod of the MoYu Redi Cube. This puzzle feels great out of the box and comes pre-stickered with high-quality vinyl stickers.

Weight: 116g

Approx Size: 57mm3

title: Cyclone Boys 6x6 G6
body_html: The Cyclone Boys G6 was the first 6x6 cube released by Cyclone Boys. Available in only stickerless this puzzles comes with Florian style holes, a very stable feel and all at a very low price.

title: ShengShou Master Pyraminx
body_html:
The ShengShou Master Pyraminx is a higher-order version of the original 3x3 Pyraminx, yet offers 4 different layers of rotation on each axis. Featuring high-quality ShengShou shades and lubed as standard from the factory makes this puzzle a great addition to any collection.

Weight: 104g

title: ShengShou Aurora Pyraminx
body_html:
The ShengShou Aurora Pyraminx is an upgraded version of the original Pyraminx released by ShengShou a few years previous. This version of the Pyraminx features Florian style holes and even torpedoes on the edges to improve stability and make for a fun solving experience.

Weight: 76g

title: QiYi QiMing A Pyraminx
body_html:
The QiYi QiMing A Pyraminx is an improved, updated version of QiYis original Pyraminx. Out of the box, the QiMing A is stable and smooth. Boasting a low price price point, this is a great starter Pyraminx for those cubers looking to step away from regular shaped NxN cubes.

Weight: 82g

title: QiYi WuQue 4x4
body_html: Released in late 2016, the QiYi WuQue 4x4 was one of the most popular 4x4 cubes of its time and is still a very good seller. The QiYi WuQue has set many records during its years of service.

title: ShengShou Petaminx
body_html:
The ShengShou Petaminx is a 9 layer Minx puzzle and is based on the old school Megaminx. There isn't much else to say about this amazing puzzle other than that it comes with a set of replacement stickers and comes pre-lubricated from the factory.

Weight: 1219g

title: ShengShou Teraminx
body_html:
The ShengShou Teraminx is a massive 7x7 layer megaminx style puzzle that will have you ripping your hair out in a matter of minutes. The first step to solving this ginormous beast is plucking up the courage to scramble it in the first place. With 12 different coloured sides the ShengShou Teraminx is a nightmare in a box. Good Luck!

Weight: 535g

featured_image.alt: ShengShou Teraminx Twisty Puzzle from KewbzUK

title: ShengShou Gigaminx
body_html:
The ShengShou Gigaminx is a 5 layer minx puzzle based on the old school Megaminx. If you think you're good at the Megaminx, try a Gigaminx.

Weight: 373g

title: LeFun Axis
body_html:
The CubeStyle (LeFun) Axis cube is a 3x3x3 shape mod featuring Florian style pieces with high-quality vinyl "Hollow" stickers. Available in a range of different colours & sticker styles.

Weight: 95g
Size: 56mm3

title: YJ Ghost 1x3x3
body_html:
The YJ Ghost 1x3x3 is an irregularly cut version of the original 1x3x3 puzzle and is based on both the 1x3x3 and the Ghost cube.

Weight: 49g

Approx Size: 2.3cm x 57mm2

title: QiYi QiCheng A Skewb
body_html:
The QiCheng A Skewb is a beginner-friendly Skewb puzzle released by QiYi and has some small upgrades compared to that of its predecessor, the QiCheng. Perfect for cubers looking to move away from the standard 3x3 and practise more WCA puzzles.

Weight: 96g

Approx Size: 56mm3

title: CubeStyle Pyraminx (Carbon)
body_html:
The CubeStyle (or Lefun) Carbon Fibre Pyraminx is based on the original stickerless version of the CubeStyle Pyraminx but has carbon fibre stickers on each of the 4 faces.

Please Note: CubeStyle has now rebranded to LeFun.

Weight: 62g

title: Adjustment Screwdriver
body_html:
Perfect for adjusting any Rubik's Cube or twisty puzzle which uses a Phillips head screw for adjustment.

Please Note: Colour may vary.

title: ShengShou Kilominx
body_html:
Known as the ShengShou Kilominx, this particular puzzle is based on a normal Megaminx yet consists entirely of corner pieces, making it slightly different in solving than that of its older brother.

Weight: 139g

title: QiYi Mirror 2x2
body_html:
The QiYi Mirror 2x2 is a shape mod of the regular 2x2 Rubik's Cube. The ultimate goal of the 2x2 Mirror cube is not to match the colours on each face, but to create a cube. Each "cubie" is a different size and shape making this an exciting puzzle to solve.

Weight: 78g

Approx Size: 57mm3

title: LanLan Gear Mastermorphix
body_html:
The LanLan Gear Mastermorphix really open yours eyes into the more complex world of cubing. Using a slightly different method to solve than that of the regular Mastermorphix, this geared version will really grind your gears.

Weight: 187g

title: LanLan Edge-Only Void
body_html:
The LanLan Edge-Only Void cube is what it says on the tin. Unlike a normal cube puzzle this one features long edges and no corners. We recommend grabbing yourself some cube lube to really make the most of this amazing little LanLan puzzle.

Weight: 121g

Approx Size: 61mm3

title: Standard Cube Stand
body_html: This product will hold any cube shaped puzzle up to the 11x11. Perfect for 2x2, 3x3, 4x4 ad 5x5 Rubik's Cubes.

title: LanLan Gear Rhombic Dodecahedron
body_html:
The LanLan Gear Rhombic Dodecahedron really is a toughy. With interlocking teeth and gears designed to throw you off at every turn, you'll be stuck on this one for a while.

Weight: 155g

title: LanLan Gear Megaminx
body_html:
The LanLan Gear Megaminx resembles that of the standard Megaminx yet offers a completely different solving style. With interlocking gears and teeth you will need to sit back and think before you are ready to solve it.

Weight: 136g

title: LanLan Gear Tetrakaidecahedron
body_html:
The LanLan Gear Tetrakaidecahedron is probably harder to say than it is to solve. Slightly based on the same method as solving the Geared 3x3 puzzles although not quite as easy. Definetly not for beginners. Do you dare?

Weight: 114g

title: QiYi WuXia 2x2
body_html: The QiYi WuXia is a non-magnetised version of the original WuXia 2x2 M speed cube. Offering great corner-cutting and a unique anti-corner twisting functionality makes this 2x2 a very popular puzzle on the speedsolving market.

title: QiYi Twisty Skewb
body_html:
Featuring high quality vinyl stickers and a mixture of different anti popping & anti locking mechanisms make the QiYi Twisty Skewb a great puzzle for any avid cuber. Released in September 2017 and designed by YuKang Wu.

Weight: 73g

Approx Size: 56mm2 x 60mm

title: QiYi WuXia 2x2 (Magnetic)
body_html: The QiYi WuXia M is a magnetised version of the original WuXia 2x2 speed cube. Offering many unique design improvements over the original and also featuring specific slots for each magnet makes the improved WuXia M one of the top-performing 2x2 speed cubes on the market.

title: ZCube CFOP Card (x3)
body_html:
Learn the advanced 3x3 CFOP tutorial with these 3 cards from Z-Cube. The F2L card helps you learn algorithms to solve the first 2 layers of the cube whilst the OLL and PLL cards aid you in solving the last layer of the 3x3.

Weight: 15g (5g each)

Approx Size: 5.4cm x 8.5cm

title: QiYi 2x2x3 Tower
body_html:
The 2x2x3 Tower puzzle is the first 2x2x3 to be produced by QiYi. Being slightly bigger than the 2x2x3 from Z-Cube makes this version much easier to hold and control. The turning is crisp and smooth and the pieces seem to be attached nicer to the core, meaning no movement in the pieces between moves.

Weight: 73g

Approx Size: 45mm2 x 67mm

title: YJ Windmill V2
body_html:
The YongJun Windmill (which is sometimes called the Wind and Fire) is a kind of 2x2x3 shape mod. Unlike the regular 3x3 Rubik's Cube this puzzle can shape shift into many different shapes making it incredibly hard to solve. YongJun have introduced a smoother more stylish version 2.

Weight: 97g

Approx Size: 56mm3

title: LanLan 1x3x3 Super Floppy
body_html:
The LanLan Super Floppy is a 1x3x3 cuboid based on 1 layer of the regular 3x3 Rubik's Cube. Unlike a floppy cube, the super floppy has a few more axis of rotation which allow you to create more wacky shapes than ever before! The LanLan 1x3x3 is one of our favourite puzzles here at the KewbzUK office.

Weight: 44g

title: QiYi CiYuan 3x3
body_html:
The QiYi 3x3 Ringed magic cube does not use the conventional vinyl stickers which occupy most other 3x3 cubes on the market. This particular puzzle offers rings of colour directly moulded into each cubie instead of individual colour stickers.

Weight: 84g

Approx Size: 56mm3

title: ShengShou Skewb
body_html:
The ShengShou Skewb was the first skewb type of twisty puzzle released by puzzle manufacturer ShengShou. Available in both Black and White colours each incorporate ball bears to help the cubes twist and lock into each other better to avoid lockups.

Weight: 103g

Approx Size: 57mm3
